name: merger-agreement
description: Drafts and reviews U.S. merger agreements (Delaware default), public or private target, including reverse triangular and 251(h) two-step mergers. Maps each defined term to its uses (Material Adverse Effect carve-outs and disproportionate-effect exceptions, Knowledge, Indebtedness, Transaction Expenses, working capital), separates representations, covenants and closing conditions, sets bring-down standards and materiality scrapes, ties the price waterfall and working capital peg, tests interim covenants for gun-jumping, and drafts indemnification baskets, caps, survival, sandbagging, R&W insurance, termination rights, outside dates, termination fees, specific performance, stockholder approval (DGCL 251, 228), appraisal (262) and 2024-2025 DGCL changes (122(18), 144, 147, 261, 268). Use for merger agreement, MAE, bring-down, ordinary course covenant or markup review. Routes HSR to hsr-filing, schedules to disclosure-schedules, diligence to due-diligence-report, and tax to analyzing-m-and-a-tax-implications.
